headline: Sri Lanka stocks open 0.69-pct down after surprise central bank rate hike
summary: Sri Lanka's stocks opened 0.69% lower after the central bank surprised markets with a rate hike. Hemas Holdings, Prime Lands, Odel and PGP Glass were among the positive contributors to the ASPI.
why: The All Share Price Index (ASPI) tracks the Colombo Stock Exchange, and central bank rate decisions directly affect borrowing costs and equity valuations.
why_moved: The central bank's surprise rate hike raised expectations of tighter financial conditions. The ASPI opened lower as a result.
